findings.claim: ADR-0003, TECH-SPEC GS4/§6.8/Q1 and ADR-0015 still say v1 unit tests are deleted. The owner decided the v1 unit tests stay: v2 is built until they pass, at least for the parts v2 keeps.
findings.evidence: ADR-0003:1 "unit tests are deleted"; :3 "delete all unit tests"; :35 "The v1 tests/ tree is deleted in one commit"; :46 "Keep unit tests for pure algorithms. Rejected". TECH-SPEC.md:37 GS4 "v1 tests/ is deleted"; :349 "is deleted in one commit"; :404 Q1 "Delete v1 tests in one commit" [D]. ADR-0015:41 "tests/: 252 files ... Deleted last"; :61 step 5 "tests/". ADR-0015:56 also replaces ci.yml first "so that v2 CI no longer runs the v1 vitest suite".
findings.fix: Rewrite ADR-0003 (new status, supersede r1): v1 tests/ kept; v2 work continues until they pass; ledger verdict per row = KEEP-PASS / GPn / REMOVED:<id>, REMOVED only for behaviour v2 drops on purpose. Change GS4 to "every kept-part v1 test passes on v2", Q1 to the new decision, ADR-0015 step 0 to keep running vitest on v2, step 5 removed. Add E2E (GP) as an extra layer, not a replacement.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: ac6a7961 2026-10-14 "docs(v2): add v2 design docs, ADRs ..." (cm-main git log). ORIGINAL_INTENT: ADR-0003:3 "delete all unit tests, keep only E2E". REGRESSION_RISK: v1 tests/ cite 221 fixed bug ids (TECH-SPEC:346); deleting them drops the only executable proof of those fixes. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: no test file deleted before its row shows the behaviour is removed by an owner decision.

findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: fbf402fd 2026-02-25 "feat: unified PreToolUse hook — block Bash data-fetching + subagent routing"; WebFetch reason text in hooks/core/routing.mjs (git log -S ctx_fetch_and_index → b9d10e2d 2026-02-25 v0.7.0, 08ca7007 2026-03-05). findings.claim: The bug form is written for a human reader. The owner rule says issue templates must address AI agents fully: an agent that reads the template must follow our rules and send the maximum debug data. ADR-0014 has no agent-directed instructions, no rule list for the agent, and it lets the human pick "did doctor run? No".
findings.evidence: ADR-0014:57 "Run /ctx-doctor, or tell the agent: call the ctx_doctor tool." Dropdown "did doctor run?" with fixed No reasons; :59 feature.yml for humans. User request in this run: "issue template i tamamen ai agentlere yonelik olmali ... maksimum debug verisini gondermeli".
findings.fix: Rewrite §5: every template body is an instruction block for the filing agent (call ctx_doctor, paste the full ctx-report unchanged, add agent name/version, the exact tool call and deny text, reproduction steps, never paraphrase, never omit a field); make the report field required; one agent-facing rule list shared by bug/feature/config.

findings.fix: State in ADR-0002: "no npm" = no npm publish and no npm at install/runtime; npm is used for the dev build on v2 only.
